headline: Roosevelt unbeaten and scoring like no one else
dek: Roosevelt have scored thirteen goals and conceded six without losing, more than Davenport, Purdue Northwest and Wisconsin-Parkside have managed between them. Only Purdue Northwest and Saginaw Valley State have otherwise gone unbeaten, and no member has yet met another.
displaced_by: Roosevelt's draw at Lake Erie moved the dek's figures to thirteen scored and six conceded; the headline stands

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Purdue Northwest have scored six goals and are unbeaten with three conceded. The chart ranks what sides score; the records so far have followed what they allow.

wire.line: Davenport have conceded ten goals already, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, and there are no score gaps: every final on the record has its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six played matches carry a result but no box score, every one of them Roosevelt's or St. Cloud State's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Estefano Alvear has conceded three goals for Purdue Northwest and kept two shutouts, a save percentage of .857.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Purdue Northwest have spread six goals across five different scorers.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's four wins are more than any other programme has managed.

last_match.line: Roosevelt stay unbeaten; Lake Erie arrived from defeat at Northern Michigan.

next_match.line: The first meeting of two members this season, though not yet a conference match; Saginaw Valley State are unbeaten.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
